core_obligations: Reduce to a local problem (proof lines 604-612): the exact sequence relating pullback differentials, differentials of the source, and relative differentials shows that the differentials of the source and their pushforward are coherent, so it suffices to construct the trace map at points of dimension one by the description of the reflexive hull.

Analyze the local case (proof lines 614-632): over a discrete valuation ring with a finite extension of degree p that is purely inseparable, the source is local and again a discrete valuation ring, and either the ramification index is p and the source is generated over the base by one element modulo a p-th power of a uniformizer, or the maximal ideal extends and the residue field extension is purely inseparable of degree p and the same presentation holds with a unit.

Apply the local trace construction (proof lines 632-636): choosing an affine open of the base scheme containing the image, the trace map on differential forms for the local model extends the trace at the generic point, which produces the required map.
proof_roadmap: Check coherence and reduce to the case of a discrete valuation ring using the reflexive hull.
Classify the local purely inseparable extension of discrete valuation rings into two cases with a common presentation.
Apply the local trace construction to extend the generic trace map.
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs a canonical trace map from the pushforward of the differential forms of the source to the reflexive hull of the differentials of the base for a finite purely inseparable morphism of degree p between Noetherian normal integral schemes over a base in characteristic p, recovering the generic trace map (statement lines 590-603). The proof (proof lines 604-636) reduces to points of dimension one, classifies the local extension of discrete valuation rings, and applies the local trace construction. H2: a complete reduction and case analysis.
